item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00413","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C25","C17","C03"],"selected_candidate_label":"C25","confidence":0.96,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C25 supplies the child’s complete two-part administrative framework: first delegating presidential foreign-assistance functions to the Secretary of State, then deeming the associated funds allocated without further presidential action. C17 and C03 contain closely related delegation-and-automatic-allocation formulations, but their primary delegatees differ from the child’s Secretary of State structure.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"There are hereby delegated to the Secretary of State the functions conferred upon the President by sections 2 and 3 of the Act","parent_excerpt":"there are hereby delegated to the Secretary of State all functions conferred upon the President ... by the Mutual Security Act of 1954","explanation":"Both use the same operative delegation formula, directed to the Secretary of State, while substituting the governing assistance statute."},{"child_excerpt":"Funds appropriated to the President ... shall be deemed to be allocated to the Secretary of State ... without any further action of the President.","parent_excerpt":"Funds heretofore or hereafter appropriated or otherwise made available to the President ... shall be deemed to be allocated or advanced without any further action of the President ...
